name: Joshi Astrals

rules.zodiac: Exactly one per sign; None for 7765 Core NFTs. Fixed manifest assignment, not probability.
rules.family_emblem: Matching family or None; must be None when Zodiac is present.
rules.environment: Rich environment matches body element; plain/gradient/None unrestricted.
rules.frame: Frame is composited last, above every other layer.
rules.badge_or_message: One badge OR positive message OR None from the same folder.
rules.mouth: Neutral Bar required on all 7,777 official NFTs; None is available for custom drafts only.
rules.crowns: Excluded: fit rejected and work paused.
rules.faces: Separate eyes/mouth only; paired layers excluded to avoid double faces.
rules.zodiac_placement: Apply [0,24] pixel render offset on the 1536px canvas; symbols remain inside every torso and clear the collar.
rules.ears: Smooth gold capsules required. Immediately after Body Material. Left (350,600), right (1086,600), each 100x310, attached to head sides.
rules.family_placement: Default family offset is [0,64]; Flowing uses [0,32] to keep waves inside the shorter Sea Glass torso.

creator: The House of Joshi
tagline: Rooted in Earth. Written in the stars.
